<noinclude>{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of ''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl'' episodes}}
This is a list of episodes of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', which first aired between September 28, 2006 and September 9, 2010 in Japan and between June 4, 2007 and February 5, 2011 in {{pmin|the United States}}, though the first three episodes were aired as a sneak peak on April 20, 2007. These episodes follow [[Ash Ketchum]] and {{an|Dawn}} in their [[Pokémon journey]] across the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]], who are joined along the way by Ash's longtime friend {{an|Brock}}.
</noinclude>
